commands.command:
set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
PI="michal@192.168.0.23"
ROOT="/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps"
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1"
EXPECTED="09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)"
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$WT/frontend/dist/index.html" | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
test -s "$BACKUP/app-before.db"
test -s "$BACKUP/index-before.html"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/head-before.sha")"
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before")"
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before")"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "PI_REPO_FAST_FORWARD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
PI_SCRIPT
RSYNC_RSH="ssh -i $KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8" rsync -az --exclude=index.html "$WT/frontend/dist/" "$PI:$ROOT/frontend/dist/"
scp -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$WT/frontend/dist/index.html" "$PI:$ROOT/frontend/dist/index.html.next"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.next | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
ASSETS=$(grep -oE '/assets/[^"]+\.(js|css)' frontend/dist/index.html.next)
test -n "$ASSETS"
for asset in $ASSETS; do
  test -s "frontend/dist$asset"
done
test -s frontend/dist/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js
echo "STAGED_INDEX_SHA256=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.next | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "INDEX_STILL_PREVIOUS=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
echo ASSETS_STAGED_WITHOUT_ACTIVATION
PI_SCRIPT
